correctness.rationale: Möbius inversion on subspace lattice F2^3 gives E tau = sum_7H 9/(9-a_H b_H) -2 sum_7L 9/(9-a_L b_L)+72/(9-a_0 b_0). The 120 possible size-three multisets of eight vectors produce exactly 5922 full-rank unordered pairs, all covered including zeros/repeats. Independent exact rational enumeration found 55 values, unique min 125/56 on 28 pairs with A=U\{0} and B any 3 distinct outside U; next min 127/56 on 42 pairs. Failing t-step histories for equality are 3(2^t+1) among 9^t, giving tail 3(2/9)^t+3(1/9)^t. The enumeration is finite AND exhaustive for the theorem domain, not extrapolated to larger codes.

evidence: Kong general MDS optimality covers only codes satisfying MDS property; binary [6,3] cannot be MDS. Bertuzzo small alphabet assumes single container, Resultary rank-two case has dimension 2.

value.rationale: This is a mathematically motivated first non-MDS small-field balanced two-container coverage depth optimum, including all repetition and zero degeneracies, its complete exact Fano-geometric equality family and full recovery tail. It fills the precise model gap identified in distributed DNA coverage literature. An exhaustive exact finite census is substantive because it covers the complete natural parameter domain.

limitations: Scope exactly two labeled capacity-three containers, rank-three binary six columns, uniform independent synchronous reads; no larger q/rank or asynchronous claim.
